privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.heading: Before using this application, please read and accept the following privacy notice.
privacy.body:
What data we store:
• Full name
• National ID number
• Phone number
• Date of birth
• Optional photo
• Optional notes
• Subscription and attendance records
• Payment records

Where data is stored:
All data is stored locally on this computer, in a private database. It is NOT sent to any server, cloud service, or third party.

Why we store it:
• To identify each player during check-in
• To manage subscriptions, sessions, and payments
• To produce attendance and financial reports

Players who are minors:
If the player is under 18, the parent or guardian must provide consent before the account is created.

How long we keep it:
Player data is kept as long as the player is a member, and for a reasonable period afterwards for accounting and legal purposes.

Your rights:
You may request to view, correct, or delete your personal data by contacting the academy administration.
privacy.footer: By clicking "I accept" you confirm you have read and agree to the notice above. If you do not agree, click "Quit" to exit.
